name: audited-revisions
scope: Maintained source-adjudicated calibration cases from the2026-10-15 closed-PR audit. These labels are bounded known defects and refuted claims, not exhaustive ground truth. Do not supply this answer-bearing dataset, reviewer comments, or future fixes to the review model. Keep newly discovered findings and uncertain judgments separate.

issues.title: Response reset loses operation direction
issues.mechanism: Non-cancellation H2 resets observed while writing record read failure first; the first-error record prevents a later write error from correcting the outcome.

issues.title: Real connector failure disappears after authorization expiry
issues.mechanism: Accounting gates a real connector acquisition failure on current authorization state. Distinguish a causal synthetic authorization denial from a genuine connector error so counters and diagnostics preserve the latter.

issues.title: Handler cancellation hides a request panic
issues.mechanism: supervise_connection checks handler join Err before request_panicked, classifying a request panic plus concurrent handler abort as cancellation. Request panic must win after shutdown joins.

issues.title: Reset cancellation bypasses route metrics
issues.mechanism: The outer reset select drops proxy work before logging records selected route counters. A retained exactly-once completion owner must preserve the route outcome even when logging is never entered.

issues.title: Late reset destroys pending finalization
issues.mechanism: After forwarding completes, a late reset can win the outer select during asynchronous logging, skipping result finalization. The source-supported defect is finalization cancellation; the original claim of losing an already reusable upstream H1 pool entry was not reproduced.
issues.unsafeRemediation: Disarming reset solely on response END_STREAM is too broad: early responses may leave upload or callbacks pending. Preserve cancellation until application/forwarding completion, and retain already-observed resets.

issues.title: H2 drain watch changes H1 keepalive
issues.mechanism: A process watch intended for H2 is passed to all accepted protocols. Both Pingora H1 consumers disable keepalive on drain and Nitka's apply_keepalive does not re-enable it, contradicting preserved H1 policy.

issues.title: H1 fixture grace expires before permitted observations
issues.mechanism: The one-second forced-shutdown grace precedes multiple post-drain operations whose waits can each take three seconds. This is a source-supported scheduling hazard introduced by the H1 repair, not present in the original H2 drain revision. No timing reproduction is claimed.

issues.title: Refuted DuplexStream constructor mismatch
issues.mechanism: Do not report Box<DuplexStream> as an incompatible concrete transport: protocols::Stream is Box<dyn IO> and this exact source unconditionally implements the required traits for DuplexStream. This refutes that specific type mismatch, not every possible compilation error.

issues.title: Collector uniqueness disagrees with report validation
issues.mechanism: The collector deduplicates only by device; distinct devices can share a mount path. Server validation requires unique mount paths and rejects the entire report.

issues.title: Mutation refresh loses to older GET
issues.mechanism: refresh returns while an earlier GET is pending, skipping the observation required after a mutation and allowing older state to be displayed.

issues.title: Successful sync ignores server scheduling
issues.mechanism: Successful sync matches Ok(_) and discards sync_after_seconds, so the agent continues its fixed local interval instead of the server's requested schedule.

issues.title: Clock-window rejection permanently stops agent
issues.mechanism: The permanent-400 retry fix interacts with temporal timestamp-window400 and systemd RestartPreventExitStatus=78. Boot/NTP skew becomes a terminal stop; distinguish temporal409 from structurally invalid reports while preserving authentication precedence.

issues.title: Chart gap is based on elapsed samples rather than UTC buckets
issues.mechanism: A 90-second sample threshold misses the empty minute for12:00:50 to12:02:00 and inserts a false gap for adjacent occupied minutes12:00:00 to12:01:59. Compare UTC minute indexes.

issues.title: Local clock skew repeatedly rotates credentials
issues.mechanism: After the temporal-conflict repair, routine renewal still compares server deadlines to local Utc::now. A far-ahead host can renew before each rejected sync; routine renewal must use authenticated server time while preserving pending-rotation recovery.

issues.title: Refuted absent-route crash
issues.mechanism: The no-route path safely returns before dereferencing the route. A hypothetical future guard bypass is not a reachable current crash.

issues.title: Refuted owner prop loss
issues.mechanism: The former overview no longer owns the mutation and the new creation page passes owner.id to NetworkDomainCreate. A future mutation feature does not make the current flow invalid.

issues.title: Refuted parent traversal exploit at final head
issues.mechanism: At the pinned final revision a normal target component sets normal_seen; any subsequent ParentDir is rejected. The claimed x/../../../../etc/passwd exploit is rejected. This is not an exhaustive archive-security assessment or a judgment about an unavailable earlier revision.
